description: Controlled single-seed 50000-round feature-representation ablation against the matching Task 2 V3.5 TD(5) experiment. Feature V4 preserves V3's five safety bits, four coin-target bits, five exact-best bomb-target bits, independent coin-distance and bomb-quality evidence, and bomb availability, but changes how they are represented in the Q-table. The learned threat-urgency entry is removed while its value remains available only to evaluation diagnostics. Coin-distance and bomb-quality classes are retained only in safety-filtered true conflicts; joint, single-objective, no-target, and local-bomb cases use dedicated inactive sentinels. Finally, all directional masks and movement actions are mapped consistently into the lexicographically minimal representative of the eight D4 rotations/reflections. There is no physical or safety action mask: exploration and exploitation still choose among all six Task 2 actions. Reward V3.5, five-step TD target, action space, visit-decay learning rate, epsilon schedule, gamma, checkpoint interval, seeds, training duration, and evaluation protocol are unchanged.
